arxiv-1804-10300.title: Optical and Electronic Properties of Molecular Systems Derived from Rhodanine
arxiv-1804-10300.creator: Duvalier Madrid-Úsuga, Carlos A. Melo-Luna, Alberto Insuasty, Alejandro Ortiz, John H. Reina
arxiv-1804-10300.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Duvalier Madrid-Úsuga, Carlos A. Melo-Luna, Alberto Insuasty, Alejandro Ortiz, John H. Reina. Push-Pull functional compounds consisting of dicyanorhodanine derivatives have attracted a lot of interest because their optical, electronic, and charge transport properties make them useful as building blocks for organic photovoltaic implementations.

arxiv-2203-17037.title: First-principles theory of intrinsic spin and orbital Hall and Nernst effects in metallic monoatomic crystals
arxiv-2203-17037.creator: Leandro Salemi, Peter M. Oppeneer
arxiv-2203-17037.description: Abstract The generation of spin and orbital currents is of crucial importance in the field of spin-orbitronics. In this work, using relativistic density functional theory and the Kubo linear-response formalism, we systematically investigate the spin Hall and orbital Hall effects for 40 monoatomic metals.

arxiv-2208-05886.title: Amplitudes, Hopf algebras and the colour-kinematics duality
arxiv-2208-05886.creator: and Congkao Wen
arxiv-2208-05886.description: Abstract It was recently proposed that the kinematic algebra featuring in the colour-kinematics duality for scattering amplitudes in heavy-mass effective field theory (HEFT) and Yang-Mills theory is a quasi-shuffle Hopf algebra. The associated fusion product determines the structure of the Bern-Carrasco-Johansson (BCJ) numerators, which are manifestly gauge invariant and with poles corresponding to heavy-particle exchange.

arxiv-2301-09640.title: Weakly-Supervised Questions for Zero-Shot Relation Extraction
arxiv-2301-09640.creator: Saeed Najafi, Alona Fyshe
arxiv-2301-09640.description: Abstract Zero-Shot Relation Extraction (ZRE) is the task of Relation Extraction where the training and test sets have no shared relation types. This very challenging domain is a good test of a model’s ability to generalize. Previous approaches to ZRE reframed relation extraction as Question Answering (QA), allowing for the use of pre-trained QA models.

arxiv-2303-05758.title: mixPGD: Hybrid Adversarial Training for Speech Recognition Systems
arxiv-2303-05758.creator: Aminul HuqWeiyi Zhang, Xiaolin Hu
arxiv-2303-05758.description: Abstract Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems based on deep neural networks are weak against adversarial perturbations. We propose mixPGD adversarial training method to improve the robustness of the model for ASR systems. In standard adversarial training, adversarial samples are generated by leveraging supervised or unsupervised methods.

arxiv-2305-04801.title: Financial Hedging and Risk Compression A journey from linear regression to neural network
arxiv-2305-04801.creator: Ali Shirazi, Fereshteh Sadeghi Naieni Fard
arxiv-2305-04801.description: Abstract Finding the hedge ratios for a portfolio and risk compression is the same mathematical problem. Traditionally, regression is used for this purpose. However, regression has its own limitations. For example, in a regression model, we can’t use highly correlated independent variables due to multicollinearity issue and instability in the results.

arxiv-2311-07300.title: Fragmentation of Colliding Liquid Rims
arxiv-2311-07300.creator: K. Tang 1, T.A.A. Adcock 1, W. Mostert 1
arxiv-2311-07300.description: Abstract We present direct numerical simulations of the splashing process between two cylindrical liquid rims. This belongs to a class of impact and collision problems with a wide range of applications in science and engineering, and motivated here by splashing of breaking ocean waves.

arxiv-2410-00765.title: Mirror and triplet energy differences in s ​ d sd -shell nuclei using microscopic interactions with isospin-symmetry breaking effects

arxiv-2410-00765.description: Abstract Starting from an isospin-symmetric microscopic interaction of Shin et al. [Phys. Rev. C 110, 034306 (2024)], we developed two isospin symmetry breaking (ISB) shell-model interactions by adding Coulomb interaction, as well as charge-symmetry breaking (CSB) and charge-independence breaking (CIB) components from the Argonne v18 (Av18) interaction at two different radial cutoffs, r c = 0.55 r_{c}=0.55 and 0.

arxiv-2410-01317.title: Decoherence and Probability
arxiv-2410-01317.creator: Richard Dawid, Karim P. Y. Thébault
arxiv-2410-01317.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Richard Dawid, Karim P. Y. Thébault. One cannot justifiably presuppose the physical salience of structures derived via decoherence theory based upon an entirely uninterpreted use of the quantum formalism. Non-probabilistic accounts of the emergence of probability via decoherence are unconvincing. An alternative account of the emergence of probability involves the combination of a partially interpreted decoherence model and an averaging of observables with respect to a positive-definite quasi-probability function and neglect of terms O ⁡ ( ℏ ) O(\hbar) .

arxiv-2504-07403.title: Multi-Selection for Recommendation Systems
arxiv-2504-07403.creator: Sahasrajit Sarmasarkar, Zhihao Jiang, Ashish Goel, Aleksandra Korolova, Kamesh Munagala
arxiv-2504-07403.description: Abstract We present the construction of a multi-selection model proposed in Goel et al. (2024) to answer differentially private queries in the context of recommendation systems. The server sends back multiple recommendations and a “local model” to the user, which the user can run locally on its device to select the item that best fits its private features.

arxiv-2602-06193.title: Experimental Quantum Bernoulli Factories via Bell-Basis Measurements
arxiv-2602-06193.creator: Tanay Roy
arxiv-2602-06193.description: Abstract Randomness processing in the Bernoulli factory framework provides a concrete setting in which quantum resources can outperform classical ones. We experimentally demonstrate an entanglement-assisted quantum Bernoulli factory based on Bell-basis measurements of two identical input quoins prepared on IBM superconducting hardware.

arxiv-2606-14288.creator: Fernando Gaibor E, Alexander López, Esther D. Gutiérrez

pmc-10693610.title: A genome assembly for Orinus kokonorica provides insights into the origin, adaptive evolution and further diversification of two closely related grass genera
pmc-10693610.creator: Kunjing Qu, Ai Liu, Mou Yin, Wenjie Mu, Shuang Wu, Hongyin Hu, Jinyuan Chen, Xu Su, Quanwen Dou, Guangpeng Ren
pmc-10693610.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Ancient whole-genome duplication (WGD) or polyploidization is prevalent in plants and has played a crucial role in plant adaptation. However, the underlying genomic basis of ecological adaptation and subsequent diversification after WGD are still poorly understood in most plants. Here, we report a chromosome-scale genome assembly for the genus Orinus (Orinus kokonorica as representative) and preform comparative genomics with its closely related genus Cleistogenes (Cleistogenes songorica as representative), both belonging to a newly named subtribe Orininae of the grass subfamily Chloridoideae.

pmc-11494308.title: Deep silicification–assisted long-term preservation of structural and genomic information across biospecies: From micro to macro
pmc-11494308.creator: Ke Liang, Liang Zhou, Qi Lei, Ting Ruan, Minmin Zhang, Jimin Guo, C. Jeffrey Brinker, Wei Zhu
pmc-11494308.description: Significance“The concurrent preservation of morphological, structural, and genomic aspects in biological samples provides researchers with comprehensive data to comprehend internal tissue architecture, cellular morphology, and genetic information dynamics, thereby fostering a holistic understanding of biological phenomena and disease mechanisms. Presently, only cryopreservation, chemical reagent fixation, and bio-plasticization are capable of simultaneously preserving these critical aspects.

pmc-11495776.title: Serum amyloid P (PTX2) attenuates hepatic fibrosis in mice by inhibiting the activation of fibrocytes and HSCs
pmc-11495776.creator: Min Cong, Raquel Carvalho Gontijo Weber, Sadatsugu Sakane, Vivian Zhang, Chunyan Jiang, Kojiro Taura, Yuzo Kodama, Samuele DeMinicis, Souradipta Ganguly, David Brafman, Shu Chien, Michael Kramer, Mark Lupher, David A. Brenner, Jun Xu, Tatiana Kisseleva
pmc-11495776.description: Background:Liver fibrosis is caused by chronic toxic or cholestatic liver injury. Fibrosis results from the recruitment of myeloid cells into the injured liver, the release of inflammatory and fibrogenic cytokines, and the activation of myofibroblasts, which secrete extracellular matrix, mostly collagen type I.

pmc-12461699.title: A robust protocol for proteomic profiling of secreted proteins in conditioned culture medium
pmc-12461699.creator: Takayoshi Otsuka, Atsushi Hatano, Masaki Matsumoto, Hideaki Matsui
pmc-12461699.description: Reliable secretome analysis is crucial for understanding cellular communication and developing therapeutic strategies. However, conventional protein quantification methods, such as the bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay, can overestimate protein concentrations in concentrated culture media, leading to inconsistent protein loading and compromised quantitative accuracy in mass spectrometry–based proteomics.

pmc-12469228.title: Pacifier Sizing as a Prescription for Better Oral Health Outcomes for Infants: A Call to Action
pmc-12469228.creator: David A Tesini, Clive Friedman, Adithya Kethu, Kristin W Hendricks, Luisa Limongelli
pmc-12469228.description: Sucking is essential for feeding and impacts the development of the cranio-facial-respiratory complex (CFRC). Non-nutritive sucking on a pacifier causes palatal narrowing and modifies the natural balanced relationship between intraoral pressure, peristaltic action of the tongue and the palate. Advanced engineering models have shown that malocclusions caused by pacifier use, are often a result of improper sizing.

pmc-12603851.title: Prophylactic adjuvant therapy for postoperative recurrence of urethral stricture: a narrative review
pmc-12603851.creator: Hongming Chen, Feng Yin, Hao Zhong, Yunqi Mo, Hongtai Tu, Zhubingyun Lai, Ruohui Huang, Junrong Zou, Rihai Xiao
pmc-12603851.description: Background and ObjectiveUrethral stenosis is a prevalent urological disorder characterized by the fibrotic narrowing of the urethral lumen, leading to symptoms of lower urinary tract obstruction and significantly impacting patients’ quality of life. Despite substantial advancements in surgical interventions, postoperative recurrence continues to pose a significant clinical challenge.

pmc-12948907.title: Artificial intelligence to investigate metabolomics data for precision medicine
pmc-12948907.creator: Antony Shenouda, Sahana Senthilkumar, Youssef Mourad, Joy Xie, Elizabeth Peker, Saman Zeeshan, Zeeshan Ahmed
pmc-12948907.description: BackgroundMetabolomic data offers insights into disease mechanisms, diagnostics, and therapeutic targets by analyzing metabolic profiles. In analyzing these profiles, traditional bioinformatic and statistical approaches, while valuable, often struggle to process high-dimensional and nonlinear metabolic data, lacking the sensitivity and adaptability that artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques provide.

pmc-13086763.title: An Investigation of Heterogeneity in Cerebellar Cortical Pathology Across Essential Tremor Cases: A Cluster Analysis
pmc-13086763.creator: Elan D. Louis, Roberto S. Hernandez, Aoife S. Weiss, Phyllis L. Faust
pmc-13086763.description: Recent years have witnessed an evolution of our understanding of the underlying neuropathological features of essential tremor (ET). Studies have revealed a cascade of neurodegenerative changes in the cerebellar cortex, centered on the Purkinje cell (PC) population and its surrounding neuronal populations and connections.

pmc-13330419.title: Methodological discordance between apical four-chamber and biplane Simpson’s method for left ventricular ejection fraction: a retrospective study of a credentialed echocardiographic dataset
pmc-13330419.creator: Hasan Burak İşleyen, Sevil Tugrul Yavuz, Sercan Bulut, Fatih Kizkapan, Cevahir Alioglu, Necla Zeynep Eren, Ali Arda Sozen, Mahsa Khanmohammadi
pmc-13330419.description: BackgroundLeft ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) remains central to heart failure phenotyping and device-based decision-making, yet the degree to which apical four-chamber (A4C) and biplane Simpson measurements diverge at clinically actionable thresholds is not well defined.MethodsWe analysed 1,022 unique algorithmically derived echocardiographic studies from 784 patients in the credentialed MIMIC-IV-ECHO-Ext-LVVOLUMES-A4C-ROI resource.

pmc-13359519.title: Initial Drug Sensitivity and Vulnerability to Substance Use Disorders: A Review of Individual Influences
pmc-13359519.creator: Shaun Smith, Judith Grisel
pmc-13359519.description: Simple SummaryPeople differ substantially in their experience of addictive drugs the first time they use them. For some, early use is rewarding and pleasurable; for others it is uncomfortable or aversive. These differences reflect genetic, developmental, sex, and life influences.
